mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mock_account (profile_code, org_code, account_num, account_name, account_type, issue_date, cash_balance) VALUES (#{profileCode}, #{orgCode}, #{accountNum}, #{accountName}, #{accountType}, #{issueDate}, #{cashBalance})
mapper.select: SELECT profile_code, org_code, account_num, account_name, account_type, issue_date, cash_balance FROM mock_account WHERE profile_code = #{profileCode} AND org_code = #{orgCode} ORDER BY account_type ASC, account_num ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE mock_account SET cash_balance = #{cashBalance} WHERE profile_code = #{profileCode} AND account_num = #{accountNum}
